_comment: Companion to quorum_unreachable_override.json (seam-embedder-findings proposal S4). It shows that a large override is not on its own a licence for an immediate negative Commitment. percentage 100 over 3 declared participants resolves to an effective threshold of ceil(100 * 3 / 100) = 3 by RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2. That threshold is reachable until a ballot rules it out, so rule 4's termination arithmetic uses the effective count, as rule 6 requires.
description: Quorum Mode: a percentage 100 override is reachable at first, so an early negative Commitment is rejected. One Reject makes it unreachable, and the negative Commitment is then accepted.

policy.description: percentage threshold of 100 (effective 3 of 3 declared participants).

messages._comment: Before any ballot, all 3 approvals remain possible and the effective threshold is 3, so neither termination clause of rule 4 holds. The Commitment MUST be rejected.
After one Reject, at most 2 approvals remain possible, which is below the effective threshold of 3. Rule 4's second clause now holds, and the negative Commitment is accepted.
